name: bounds-low
says: the low corner of the box that encloses the craft with its booms out

name: bounds-high
says: the high corner of the box that encloses the craft with its booms out

name: bus-profile
says: the bus profile: the axis at the bottom as shares of the radius and of half the height (z unused)

name: bus-profile
says: the bus profile: the rim at the bottom (z unused)

name: bus-profile
says: the bus profile: the rim at the top (z unused)

name: bus-profile
says: the bus profile: the axis at the top (z unused)

name: foot-sole
says: the run from the toe of a foot to the end of its sole

name: bus-mast-top
says: the top of the short mast under the bus

name: bus-mast-bottom
says: the bottom of the short mast under the bus

name: dish-centre
says: the centre of the high-gain reflector against the bus

name: boom-head-size
says: the width height and depth of an instrument head on the magnetometer boom

name: rtg-base
says: where the generator boom leaves the bus

name: science-base
says: where the science boom leaves the bus

name: platform-size
says: the width height and depth of the scan platform

name: platform-corner
says: the minimum corner of the scan platform against its mount

name: scan-heads
says: the mount of the first camera or spectrometer head against the platform

name: scan-heads
says: the mount of the second camera or spectrometer head against the platform

name: scan-camera-size
says: the width height and depth of the box beside the scan heads

name: scan-camera-corner
says: the minimum corner of that box against the platform

name: scan-plate-size
says: the width height and depth of the plate behind the scan heads

name: scan-plate-corner
says: the minimum corner of that plate against the platform

name: bracket-start
says: where the calibration bracket leaves the platform

name: bracket-end
says: where the calibration bracket ends beside its target

name: target-size
says: the width height and depth of the calibration target

name: target-corner
says: the minimum corner of the calibration target against the platform
